presets.label: Zoom in
presets.feel: a steady push towards the middle

presets.label: Zoom out
presets.feel: pulls back to show the whole picture

presets.label: Pan left
presets.feel: the camera slides to the left

presets.label: Pan right
presets.feel: the camera slides to the right

presets.label: Hold still
presets.feel: no movement; lets a strong picture breathe

presets.label: Tilt up
presets.feel: the camera looks up through the picture

presets.label: Tilt down
presets.feel: the camera looks down through the picture

presets.label: Dolly in
presets.feel: moves in with a slight drift up

presets.label: Dolly out
presets.feel: moves back with a slight drift down

presets.label: Handheld
presets.feel: a tiny natural wobble, like a camera held by hand

notes: rects[k] = the window (x, y, w, h) in picture pixels of clip frame k: t = k / (frames - 1) (0 for one frame), E = ease(t), centre linear in E, size w0 * (w1 / w0)^E, handheld wobble amplitude * w * shake(k / fps, seed), then kept inside the cover region
